citeAs: Grigor Bezirganyan, Sana Sellami, Laure Berti-Équille, and Sébastien Fournier. 2025. LUMA: A Benchmark Dataset for Learning from Uncertain and Multimodal Data. In Proceedings of the 48th International ACM SIGIR Conference on Research and Development in Information Retrieval (SIGIR '25), July 13–18, 2025, Padua, Italy. ACM, New York, NY, USA. https://doi.org/10.1145/3726302.3730302
creator: Grigor Bezirganyan, Sana Sellami, Laure Berti-Équille, Sébastien Fournier (Aix Marseille Univ, CNRS, LIS; IRD, ESPACE-DEV)
description: LUMA (Learning from Uncertain and Multimodal data) is a multimodal benchmark dataset featuring audio, image, and textual data from 50 classes, specifically designed for learning from uncertain data. It includes 101,000 images, 135,096 speech audio recordings, and 62,875 text passages (~3 GB total), extending CIFAR-10/100 with audio samples from three corpora and text generated by the Gemma-7B LLM. The dataset enables controlled injection of varying types and degrees of uncertainty (aleatoric and epistemic) for benchmarking multimodal uncertainty quantification methods.
name: LUMA
rai:annotationsPerItem: 2 annotations per audio sample (for manual validation)
rai:annotatorDemographics: 17 annotators in total; described as colleagues (M.Sc. and PhD students, and professors) with advanced to fluent English knowledge.
rai:dataAnnotationAnalysis: Inter-annotator agreement of 71.61% was achieved for manual audio validation. 5,027 samples were accepted where both annotators confirmed validity. Samples with conflicting annotations were rejected.
rai:dataAnnotationPlatform: Label Studio (academic license provided by HumanSignal team)
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Audio manual validation: Annotators were presented with an audio sample and the prompt "Is the audio saying the word below? (An extra 's' or 'es' in the pronunciation is okay.)" with answer options "Yes" or "No". Only samples where both annotators confirmed validity were accepted; samples with conflicting annotations were rejected. Automatic validation used OpenAI Whisper Large V3 transcription — samples whose transcription matched the class label (or plural form) were accepted without manual review.
rai:dataBiases: Gender bias was identified in generated text for classes "man", "woman", "boy", and "girl" — these classes showed a high proportion of gender-biased text according to Gemma-7B bias detection. Examples of biased text are provided in the paper. Prompts were reconstructed for these 4 classes using occupation-focused keywords to reduce bias; unbiased texts (>800 per class) were retained after filtering. The authors acknowledge that LLM-generated text may contain factual inaccuracies or biases, and note that the accuracy and consistency of the Gemma-based bias detection cannot be fully assessed. Audio data from forced alignments may contain misaligned segments introducing additional noise.
rai:dataCollection: Images were compiled from CIFAR-10/100 (32x32 images), supplemented with EDM diffusion-generated images for diversity control. Audio samples were extracted from three corpora: The Spoken Wikipedia (phoneme-level aligned), LibriSpeech (force-aligned via Montreal Forced Aligner), and Mozilla Common Voice (force-aligned); 73 additional recordings were voluntarily contributed by colleagues. Text passages were generated using Google's Gemma-7B Instruct LLM with 13 different prompts per class label. The dataset covers 50 classes (42 in-distribution, 8 OOD), with 600 samples per class (500 train, 100 test) for in-distribution classes.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Images: CIFAR-10/100 dataset (32x32 pixel images) and EDM diffusion-generated images. Audio: The Spoken Wikipedia corpus (hundreds of hours of phoneme-level aligned audio), LibriSpeech corpus (1,000 hours of English speech from audiobooks), and Mozilla Common Voice corpus (crowdsourced open-source voice recordings); plus 73 voluntarily contributed recordings. Text: Generated by Gemma-7B Instruct LLM using 13 prompt templates per class label.
rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Manual Human Curator, Software Collection
rai:dataLimitations: Since textual data was generated using an LLM, the dataset may contain factual inaccuracies or biases; LUMA shall not be used as a source of knowledge or information. Audio samples from forced alignments may be misaligned, introducing additional noise. Voluntary audio contributions may include very noisy samples or samples with strong accents. The dataset is intended for benchmarking uncertainty quantification in multimodal classification settings, not for general knowledge retrieval.
rai:dataManipulationProtocol: The Python package supports controlled injection of uncertainty: (1) Data diversity control — deep features extracted (Wav2Vec for audio, BERT for text, VGG-11 for images) and samples drawn from a categorical distribution weighted by inverse distance to class center raised to power k; (2) Sample noise injection — background noise from ESC-50 added to audio via audiomentations library; text noise via nlpaug (keyboard, OCR, random character, antonym, random word, spelling, back-translation); image noise via 15 perturbation types (Gaussian noise, shot noise, impulse noise, blur types, weather effects, etc.); (3) Label noise injection — subset of samples selected by user-defined probability, labels reassigned to nearest class based on deep feature distances; (4) OOD injection — 8 classes held out as OOD samples.
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Audio: Class label set extended with plural forms; audio segments extracted from aligned transcripts; automatic validation using OpenAI Whisper Large V3 (130,069 of 178,123 samples validated automatically); manual validation via Label Studio for remaining samples (8,372 samples scheduled for manual labeling); anonymization and trimming of voluntarily contributed recordings. Text: Generated texts validated by masking label occurrences and re-classifying with Gemma-7B Instruct; 55,953 texts accepted. Bias detection performed using Gemma model; prompts reconstructed for 4 biased classes (man, woman, boy, girl) with occupation-focused keywords to reduce gender bias. Images: 42 classes selected with ≥600 samples; 8 classes with <600 samples designated as OOD.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset is intended to promote the development of trustworthy and robust machine learning approaches for safety-critical applications such as healthcare and autonomous driving. The authors anticipate that LUMA will help the research community design more trustworthy and robust ML approaches. Gender bias in LLM-generated text for human-related classes (man, woman, boy, girl) was identified and partially mitigated through prompt reconstruction.
rai:dataUseCases: Benchmarking multimodal deep learning algorithms on uncertain data; evaluating and developing uncertainty quantification methods (aleatoric and epistemic) for multimodal learning; studying model robustness to noise; out-of-distribution (OOD) detection research; benchmarking trustworthy and robust multimodal deep learning approaches for safety-critical applications (e.g., healthcare, autonomous driving).
rai:machineAnnotationTools: OpenAI Whisper Large V3 (used for automatic audio transcription and validation); Google Gemma-7B Instruct (used for text generation and for bias detection in generated texts, and for text validation by masked label re-classification); Montreal Forced Aligner (used to generate word-level alignments for LibriSpeech and Mozilla Common Voice audio).
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: 73 voluntarily contributed audio recordings from colleagues were anonymized before inclusion in the dataset.
